name: The Art of the Imbue
label: Quest
description: The Art of the Imbue: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The harvesting of precious gems is of utmost importance to our craft, friend. Few gems are more precious than the citrine. The magical properties we imbue into our goods are amplified greatly by the presence of citrine.
For this lesson, we will fortify forty bars of mithril with four citrines. The result will be a better understanding of magical gemology and the knowledge to create ornate mithril shoulders.

clips.title: Progress
paras: After such mining, your muscles bulge and your body aches!

clips.title: Completion
paras: One can barely keep their eyes from leaving its splendor, friend. Aye, citrine is a glorious gem.
Pay attention and learn what such a discovery may teach us!
